## Houston 1.0.14

### What's new

- Each card on the board now shows when you last talked with that AI employee: the time if it was today, then "Yesterday", the day of the week, or the date. Hover it for the full date and time. The same time shows in the chat header and in the task list on your phone.
- On narrow boards, like with the chat open, the time on each card always shows in full. To make room, rename and delete move into a "More actions" button on the card.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
